snippet.title: DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/dw3-re/us/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=LaunchUS&utm_id=Caption

After 25 years, a classic is reborn! DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends return for the modern era. Using Unreal Engine 5, the officers and battlefields of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 have been recreated in stunning detail.
 
Take 1 vs. 1,000 action to new heights with even more exhilarating combat! While faithfully recreating the feel and movement of the original game, the action system of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 has evolved to deliver an even more thrilling experience.
 
A demo featuring the special scenario “Battle of Hulao Gate (Allied Forces)” is now available.
Six officers are playable: Zhao Yun, Guan Yu, Xiahou Dun, Zhen Ji, Zhou Yu, and Sun Shangxiang.You can also enjoy Classic Settings, which offers a gameplay experience closer to the original title.

https://www.koeitecmoamerica.com/dw3-re/us/demo/demo.html

Join the #KTFamily
Twitter: https://x.com/KoeiTecmoUS
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/koeitecmous  
IG: https://www.instagram.com/koeitecmous/
Discord:  https://discord.com/invite/KTFamily
